bad_debt_measurement_boundary: Use the canonical liquidation owner without correction. Realised bad debt is retained as registered, but a structurally zero result under full-close canonical repayment semantics is reported as a measurement limitation and is not retuned.

A1.beneficial_rule: at least two paired 95% intervals below zero and no clearly adverse realised-bad-debt interval
A1.supported: at least two diversified portfolios satisfy

A2.consistent: clean ETH-only negative control and at least two informative non-decreasing raw metrics
A2.inconsistent: clean ETH-only negative control and no informative non-decreasing raw metric
A2.invalid: experiment validity failure or non-zero direct ETH-only WBTC loss
A2.mixed: clean ETH-only negative control and exactly one informative non-decreasing raw metric
A2.normalised_rule: interpret exposure-normalised outcomes separately and require the ETH-only direct-loss negative control
A2.raw_gradient_rule: at least two informative, non-constant metrics among liquidated debt, backlog and bad debt are non-decreasing with initial WBTC exposure

decision_rules.A3: all price-isolation, path-order and accounting audits pass
decision_rules.h3_exhaustive_resolution: apply the named supported, partially-supported and exposure-effect-only cases first; otherwise classify a valid but contradictory or unsupported combination as H3_no_clear_idiosyncratic_diversification

horizon.translation_rule: prepend 24 ordinary hours, retain the registered 216-hour kernel byte-for-byte, then retain its terminal multiplier

peg_solvency_rule.comparison_basis: each diversified portfolio against eth_only under the ETH idiosyncratic shock
peg_solvency_rule.divergence_rule: a solvency-beneficial portfolio is peg-adverse, or solvency and peg benefits occur only in disjoint portfolios
peg_solvency_rule.portfolio_peg_classification: at least three of five paired 95% intervals in one direction

purpose: Estimate idiosyncratic-shock diversification effects without ranking or selecting a portfolio.
